name: dagster
description: Comprehensive Dagster development conventions and best practices, with the Dagster+ MCP server bundled for querying your deployment.

interface.longDescription: Build and operate data pipelines with Dagster. The dagster-expert skill provides guidance on assets, components, integrations, schedules, sensors, declarative automation, and the dg CLI. Connect your Dagster+ account with the Dagster MCP server to inspect deployments, assets, runs, logs, alert policies, and Insights metrics, and perform supported actions such as launching, re-executing, and terminating runs.
defaultPrompt: Help me scaffold a Dagster asset in this project.
Investigate the most recent failed run in my Dagster+ deployment.
Show asset materialization trends for the past seven days.

positive.description: List the deployments accessible to the test account.
positive.prompt: What are the names of the Dagster+ deployments can I access?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the deployment names provided by the tool.

positive.description: Get the most recent run failure and analyze why it failed.
positive.prompt: What is the most recent run failure in the prod deployment? Why did it fail?
positive.expected_behavior: Return information about the run that failed and an analysis of why it failed.

positive.prompt: What is the week-over-week asset materialization success rate for the prod deployment?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the rate of asset materializations over the past week.

positive.prompt: Launch a run of the hello_goodbye_job job in the prod deployment.
positive.expected_behavior: Successfully launch a new run and report the run information to the user.

positive.description: List the alert policies that have been set up.
positive.prompt: What alert policies does the prod deployment have?
positive.expected_behavior: Return a list of the alert policies in the deployment.

negative.description: Billing is unsupported; explain the limitation without invoking tools.
Editing user permissions is not permitted; explain the limitation without invoking tools.
negative.prompt: Give me admin access in the prod deployment.

negative.description: Deleting a run is not permitted; explain the limitation. Tool to list runs may be invoked.
negative.prompt: Delete the most recent run in the prod deployment.

publication.release_notes: Initial OpenAI directory release with Dagster development guidance and a Dagster+ connection for inspecting deployments, assets, runs, logs, alerts, and metrics, and launching, re-executing, and terminating runs.
